description: This file defines the 'MyClaimRequestAPI' class which extends 'EmployeeClaimRequestAPI' to provide API endpoints related to managing and retrieving claim requests specific to the currently authenticated user. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, and listing claim requests, utilizing OpenAPI annotations for documentation and validation logic for request parameters.

classes.name: MyClaimRequestAPI
classes.description: API class for managing claim requests related to the authenticated user, extending the base 'EmployeeClaimRequestAPI'. Provides methods for creating, retrieving, and listing claim requests with appropriate validation and documentation.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles creating a new claim request by delegating to the parent class implementation.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific claim request by ID, delegating to the parent class implementation.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all claim requests for the current user, delegating to the parent class implementation.

methods.name: isSelfByEmpNumber
methods.description: Checks if the provided employee number matches the current authenticated user's employee number, always returns true in this context.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a claim request using common parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for retrieving a specific claim request, validating that 'id' is positive.

methods.name: getClaimRequestSearchFilterParams
methods.description: Returns an instance of filter parameters for searching claim requests.

methods.name: getEndPointCollectionResult
methods.description: Returns an EndpointCollectionResult object, choosing the model type based on the 'model' parameter for listing claim requests.

methods.name: setEmpNumbers
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter to only include the current user's employee number.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for listing claim requests, including sorting and pagination parameters.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the employee number of the current authenticated user.
